name: Aramex eCommCore
author: aramex

sections.description:
eCommCore seamlessly integrates WooCommerce with Aramex Unified Portal, enabling automatic order transmission, shipment creation, live tracking updates, and near real-time stock sync.

This plugin is designed for merchants who use Aramex Unified Portal (WMS + Last-mile) for eCommerce fulfillment and shipping.

Key Features

  • Automatic order submission to Aramex Unified Portal
  • Shipment creation directly from WooCommerce
  • Real-time shipment status and tracking updates
  • Near real-time stock synchronization
  • Support for COD & prepaid orders
  • Tracking link visible in WooCommerce order details
  • Secure token-based API communication

Use Cases

  • Stores shipping with Aramex Unified Portal
  • Businesses needing real-time warehouse stock sync
  • Stores requiring automated shipping label + tracking updates
  • Hybrid fulfillment via Aramex + in-house inventory

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active Aramex Unified Portal account (WMS Access)

External Services

This plugin connects to Aramex Unified Portal & Tracking services.

  1. Aramex Unified Portal API

    • Purpose: Order submission, shipment creation, status updates, stock sync
    • Data Sent: Order details, shipping address, AWB number, inventory info
    • Terms: https://www.aramex.com/sa/en/terms-and-conditions
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.aramex.com/sa/en/legal-details/privacy-policy

  2. Aramex Shipment Tracking

    • Purpose: Order tracking page
    • Data Sent: AWB number only

All communication is secure and encrypted. Only shipping-related data necessary for fulfillment is shared.

Privacy Policy

This plugin:

  • Stores Aramex token securely
  • Sends order and shipment data to Aramex for fulfillment
  • Does not send sensitive user data elsewhere

Support

For help & onboarding, contact:
* Aramex Support: https://www.aramex.com/sa/en/support/help-center

Credits

  • Built by Aramex
  • Follows WordPress Coding Standards & WooCommerce API guidelines

License

This plugin is licensed under GPL v2 or later.
See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/aramex-ecommcore
  2. Activate plugin via WordPress Admin → Plugins
  3. Navigate to eCommCore and Activate
  4. Click on Admin Menu Called eCommCore
  5. Click Continue and Fulfill all details to connect your store
sections.faq:
Do I need an Aramex account?

Yes, an active Aramex Unified Portal account is required.

Does this support COD shipping?

Yes — COD & prepaid both supported.

Is manual sync available?

Not Directly — but you can trigger manual sync from the ecommcore dashboard.

Does it support variable products?

Yes — full support for simple & variable products.

Is customer data secure?

Yes — secure token-based communication & sanitized requests.
